assumptions.statement: The repository provisional rough overall-design and key-area polygons are used as temporary constraints.
assumptions.impact: All area-sensitive figures and spatial interfaces require recalculation when official polygons arrive.
assumptions.trigger: Replace geometry/site_boundary.geojson and geometry/key_areas.geojson with reviewed official data, regenerate all derived layers and rerun self-check.

assumptions.statement: Approved regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities, fire safety, underground space and heritage controls are absent.
assumptions.impact: FAR, height and parcel-level demolish/renovate/retain decisions remain pending; current massing is conceptual.

assumptions.statement: Named spaces, operators, annual events and funding paths are proposed governance models.
assumptions.impact: Each requires owner, community, authority and professional-team agreement before implementation.

assumptions.statement: Historic narratives use cited official public pages; site-scale soundscape claims remain limited to documented bell and railway history.
assumptions.impact: No claim of continuous daily bell sound across the surrounding district is made.

assumptions.statement: Public AI scenarios assume purpose limitation, minimum necessary data, human review, accessible alternatives and documented stop conditions.
assumptions.impact: Operators must complete service-specific legal, security, accessibility and ethical review.
